context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 6 features all implemented and tested: 1) GET /api/reviews/order/{orderId} returns product_reviews, driver_review, has_reviews flag - used by OrderTrackingPage to check if user already reviewed, 2) POST /api/reviews stores order_id in review document, 3) Duplicate review for same product/user blocked with 400 error, 4) Review comment minimum 20 characters enforced on both product and driver reviews, 5) Product reviews API returns image_urls field which is rendered in CataloguePage, 6) Loyalty points selector changed from slider to <select> dropdown (multiples of 100), 7) Reviews are read-only once submitted (no edit/delete), 8) +5 loyalty points per review credited on first submit only. Note: carttest@koya.com has 25 loyalty points (not enough for 100 to see dropdown).
